item.title: Wd20251106
item.description:
For details please visit the page

This page contains a canvas in which cars move from the right to the left or left to right (based on user choice), the user can adjust the percantage of certain types of cars. The canvas will fill the entire remaining space below the controls.

Cars 
    1. Red
    2. Yellow
    3. Green
    4. Black 
    5. Blue

The cars will slow down if they bump into the car in front of them
